manifest.command.detect.title: Detect Unicode Risks
manifest.command.scan-workspace.title: Scan Workspace for Unicode Risks
manifest.command.scan-folder.title: Scan Folder for Unicode Risks
manifest.command.settings.title: Open Settings
manifest.command.help.title: Help & Troubleshooting
manifest.settings.title: Unicode-LE Settings
manifest.settings.clipboard.positions.de: Include each line and column in the copy on the clipboard. Only matters when the result is copied.
manifest.settings.copy.clipboard.desc: Copy each report to the clipboard as well as opening it
manifest.settings.kinds.desc: Report only these kinds of finding. Leave empty for every kind, which is the only setting under which an empty report means clean.
manifest.settings.kinds.option.bidi: Bidirectional controls: the Trojan Source class (CVE-2021-42574)
manifest.settings.kinds.option.confusabl: Homoglyphs and compatibility forms of ASCII characters
manifest.settings.kinds.option.mixed-scr: Words that no single script accounts for
manifest.settings.kinds.option.non-nfc: Lines that are not in Normalization Form C
manifest.settings.scripts.desc: Non-Latin scripts your files are written in, by Unicode name or ISO 15924 tag, e.g. Han, Cyrillic or Hira. Naming them lets the homoglyph and mixed-script checks run on translated files instead of refusing them.
manifest.settings.open.side-by-side.desc: Open the report in a new editor to the side
manifest.settings.safety.enabled.desc: Enable safety checks for large files and operations
Size in bytes above which the active document gets a warning and a workspace file is left unread
manifest.settings.show.positions.desc: Show the line and column of each finding
manifest.settings.statusbar.enabled.desc: Show the Unicode-LE status bar entry for quick access
manifest.settings.telemetry.desc: Enable local-only telemetry logs to the Output panel
manifest.settings.workspace.excludes.des: Glob patterns of more files a folder or workspace scan skips, on top of the built-in list. Example: **/fixtures/**
manifest.settings.workspace.max-files.de: The most files one folder or workspace scan reads
manifest.settings.workspace.patterns.des: Glob patterns of the files a folder or workspace scan reads
manifest.mcp.label: Unicode-LE Unicode risk detection for agent mode
The most results one folder or workspace scan reports before it stops reading
manifest.settings.workspace.gitignore.de: Leave out the files the project's .gitignore files leave out
manifest.settings.workspace.always-inclu: Glob patterns of files a folder or workspace scan reads even when the built-in list or .gitignore would skip them. Example: **/vendor/**
manifest.settings.workspace.binary.desc: Skip images, fonts, archives and other files that are not text
manifest.settings.workspace.default-excl: Skip dependency folders, build output, caches and lockfiles, such as node_modules, dist, .next and package-lock.json
manifest.settings.workspace.problems.des: Also show a folder or workspace scan's findings in the Problems panel
